attributes.title: 2027 FNPN Annual Conference: There's No Place Like FNPN
attributes.series: Florida Nurse Practitioner Network Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
Florida NPs can build a schedule around six tracks in Orlando, August 12 to 14, 2027: pharmacology, acute care, aging health, business, metabolic health and leadership. The draft agenda credits sessions individually, with 0.5 CE for podium talks and 2.0 for preconference workshops, but a conference total and fees are not published yet.

If you want to present, abstracts for workshops, podium talks and posters are due January 30, 2027.
